description: Offsets and scales each of up to eight channels of a polyphonic signal, a knob pair per channel

params.text: Adds a voltage to that channel, up to 5V either way; when that channel's jack carries a CV, the knob attenuverts it instead
Scales that channel's voltage, from full level through silence to full level inverted
The channel count when IN is unpatched, from 1 to 8

inputs.text: With IN in use this is a CV over that channel's offset, 5V either way and attenuverted by the OFFSET knob; with IN unpatched it is that channel's own input
With a cable at IN it processes that signal's channels

outputs.text: Every channel after its own offset and scale, merged into one polyphonic cable and clamped at 12V

notes: with nothing patched to IN, it merges the per-channel inputs and knob voltages into a polyphonic output, which makes it a replacement for Rack's MERGE
menu: Range — sets the voltage span the knobs cover: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-2V, +/-1V, 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V, 0V-2V or 0V-1V
Order of operations — Scale, then offset multiplies first and adds the offset after; Offset, then scale adds first and multiplies after
